collection.title: Mercedes-Benz SLC Class 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz SLC Class Coupe 2016 Onwards (173) will fit, this model requires a 22 wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
